description: Zig HTTP/3 server on the zix.Http3 engine, pure-Zig QUIC on std.crypto (RFC 9000/9001/9002/9114), .URING dispatch: one SO_REUSEPORT worker per core on UDP 8443, TLS 1.3 inside the QUIC handshake, NewReno congestion control with PTO retransmit, and rolling flow-control credit (MAX_STREAMS and MAX_DATA replenished as the client spends them). A one-worker https responder on TCP 8443 answers the harness readiness probe, idle during the measured run.
